errors.evidence: Colors and labels for the models are incorrectly reported; correct colors include light blue for mBERT-L2, dark blue for XLM-L2, light green for mBERT-R2, dark green for XLM-R2, red for mBERT-B2, and dark red for XLM-B2.
IE-Romance is improperly labeled; it is not represented by a separate bar.
The description does not mention that the horizontal axis represents language families in an ordered sequence.
The detailed comparison of effects across different models by language families is not sufficiently outlined.
The description does not explain that error bars indicate standard deviation for each model represented.
